headlines.title: Most Americans think AI is doing more harm than good in schools
headlines.description: Most American adults think artificial intelligence is going to do more harm than good in education, according to this month’s NBC News Decision Desk Poll powered by SurveyMonkey.

headlines.title: Canada poised to become European Union's first 'associate member'
headlines.description: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney told the European Parliament in France that he is interested in making his country the first "associate member" of the E.U. It comes as Canada and western Europe's relationship with the U.S. has become strained in recent months. NBC News' Matt Bodner explains the benefits of the new alliance.

headlines.title: New wild cat species is identified for first time in 100 years, researchers say
headlines.description: Researchers say they’ve identified a new species of wild cat previously unknown to science. The Tilcayo tiger cat is smaller than a typical house cat and lives in the Bolivian cloud forest.

headlines.title: What Does the Interest Rate Hike Mean for American Consumers?
headlines.description: The Federal Reserve raised interest rates for the first time since 2023 on Wednesday in a move aimed at slowing inflation. NBC’s Brian Cheung joins TODAY to break down how the 0.25% hike will impact credit cards, mortgages and the cost of food and gas.

headlines.title: Texas college quarterback apologizes for comments about violent AI video
headlines.description: Texas Longhorns quarterback Arch Manning apologized for referencing an AI video showing his coach slapping ESPN sideline reporter Holly Rowe. “In my press conference yesterday, I made an insensitive comment about an AI video. There is nothing funny about it,” Manning wrote.

headlines.title: Australian athlete apologizes after winning race despite involuntary bowel movement
headlines.description: An Australian athlete apologized Thursday for continuing — and winning — her race in China over the weekend after experiencing an involuntary bowel movement during competition.

headlines.title: How Canada and the E.U. are teaming up to counter Trump
headlines.description: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney addressed the European Parliament in Strasbourg to lay out how middle powers might counteract Trump’s hostility.

headlines.title: DNA links Arizona man who died by suicide to 1987 cemetery murder of Navy veteran
headlines.description: The DNA of an Arizona man who died by suicide earlier this year has connected him to the unsolved slaying of a Navy veteran whose body was dumped in a cemetery four decades ago, prosecutors said.

headlines.description: Researchers say they’ve identified a new species of wild cat previously unknown to science. The Tilcayo tiger cat is smaller than a typical house cat and lives in the Bolivian cloud forest.

headlines.title: Democratic senators request Pentagon provide ‘bare minimum’ on cost of Iran war
headlines.description: Nearly the entire Democratic caucus in the Senate is demanding that Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth provide Congress with a full accounting of the cost of the war in Iran along with related budget requests, as frustration grows that the Pentagon is not being forthcoming about the war and its fiscal impact.

headlines.title: Texas abortion ban caused pregnant woman’s death, lawsuit says
headlines.description: The family of a Texas woman who died from a pregnancy-related complications is suing state Attorney General Ken Paxton and the hospital where she was treated, claiming the state’s ban on most abortions killed her.

headlines.title: Salvadorans with TPS don’t know how long their protections will last
headlines.description: José Palma of the National TPS Alliance says wrong paperwork or advice can jeopardize future immigration status, as he argues immigrants here for 25 years should have a “permanent solution.”
